Haters function as the evil version of the [textlink="Secretary" link="Secretary"], being assigned to a random person to ensure that they do not complete all of their objectives. Like the Secretary, they only target secret identities which have personal objectives.
The Hater wins if their target does not complete all of their objectives. Even if it's a partial success or they complete a few objectives, the Hater will still count it as a win.
Additionally, the Hater must try and ensure that their target does not die. Although they HATE them, a grudge is a two-way often highly-romantic street, and the Hater would be left emotionally destitute if their target were to die. If they do end up dying, the Hater can still succeed at their other objective.
